entities.name: Venser
entities.description: An artificer from Urborg on Dominaria and a planeswalker who built teleportation devices, helped close the time rifts, and gave his life and spark to Karn on Mirrodin; his corpse was later made a Phyrexian.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: The swampy region of Dominaria where Venser was born and lived in a workshop.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane that is Venser's home.

entities.name: Ambulator
entities.description: A magical teleportation device built by Venser, later rebuilt with Thran metal and powerstones.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who found Venser while researching the rift above Urborg.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Companion of Teferi who recruits Venser's talents and calls Karn; in the Echoverse a pirate.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: An elvish barbarian with a mutated spark among Teferi's companions.

entities.name: Sensei Ryu
entities.description: The disembodied voice who takes hold of Venser's mind and is revealed as the elder dragon Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker who re-enters the material world using Venser's will and spark, then leaves after a threat to Kamigawa.

entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: Ruler of Urborg whose gladehunters guard it against artifice; he makes Venser a gladehunter.

entities.name: Weaver King
entities.description: A being who impersonates Karn, removes Windgrace's mark and infests Venser's mind, and is killed by Venser.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem who closes the Tolarian rift with Venser's help and is later found corrupted by Phyrexian oil on Mirrodin.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes where Venser meets Karn.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Karn's apprentice who studies the rifts and casts Venser and Radha back to perform the Mending alone.

entities.name: The Mending
entities.description: The event in which Jeska sacrificed herself to close the time rifts.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A native of Mirrodin who traps Venser's head in a stone mask and commands him to planeswalk to Mirrodin.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A warrior planeswalker who accompanies Koth and Venser and grows protective of Melira.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The artificial plane of Karn, invaded by Phyrexians.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A Sylvok Mirran born without metal, immune to phyresis, who can heal it and cleanses Karn's body.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A Phyrexian leader who guides the companions and later captures Elspeth and Venser.

entities.name: Ezuri
entities.description: The elf leader of a band of Mirran rebels who profited from the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: A Phyrexian who assaults Venser at the shrine to Karn.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: A Phyrexian who leads a force that breaks through and taunts the companions.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A Phyrexian whose troops unearth Venser's corpse and make it a corpse puppet.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders of Mirrodin who experiment on creatures and corrupt Karn.

entities.name: Phyresis
entities.description: The Phyrexian oil infection, which Melira is immune to and can heal.

events.summary: Venser lives alone in a workshop in the Urborg swamps, salvaging Phyrexian remains and building his Ambulator while drawing Windgrace's ire.
events.quote: he lived alone in a workshop within the Urborg swamps, salvaging parts from the remains of Phyrexians left from the Invasion

events.summary: Teferi finds Venser while researching the rift above Urborg.
events.quote: He had little success until the planeswalker Teferi found him while researching the rift above Urborg.

events.summary: Venser and Teferi's companions are swept through the rifts and deposited above Madara, where Radha faces the cat dragons.
events.quote: finally being deposited upon the cliffs overlooking the shores of Madara

events.summary: Sensei Ryu takes hold of Venser's mind and uses his will and spark to re-enter the material world as Bolas.
events.quote: Ryu took hold of Venser's mind and used his will and spark to re-enter the material world in full dread glory

events.summary: Teferi challenges Bolas to a duel and is demolished; Radha talks Bolas out of taking more than their guard Aprem's life, and Bolas departs with a threat to Kamigawa.
events.quote: with a dire threat against the inhabitants of Kamigawa , Bolas departed

events.summary: Venser travels with Jhoira to the Ghitu and perfects his throne device with Thran metal and powerstones.
events.quote: Venser managed to perfect his throne device, now constructed of Thran metal and ringed with newly created powerstones

events.summary: A flaw in the device sends Venser, Teferi and Jhoira to an alternate timeline, and Venser completes his first planeswalk home.
events.quote: Teferi and Jhoira use their magic to help Venser complete his first planeswalk back to the Dominaria they knew

events.summary: Windgrace catches Venser, who becomes one of his gladehunters.
events.quote: Venser agreed to become one of Windgrace's gladehunters, taking the planeswalker's mark upon his skin

events.summary: The Weaver King, impersonating Karn, infests Venser's mind in the Blind Eternities; Venser kills it using his planeswalking and powerstones.
events.quote: Venser was able to then kill the Weaver King through the cunning use of his planeswalking ability

events.summary: Venser helps Karn close the Tolarian rift and is the last person Karn speaks to before disappearing.
events.quote: Venser would be the last person Karn spoke to before his disappearance.

events.summary: Jeska studies the rifts, uses Radha as her tool, and is stopped by Venser and company at great cost to Radha's spark and Zhalfir.
events.quote: only after grievous damage had been done to Radha's spark and Zhalfir

events.summary: Jeska casts Venser and Radha back and sacrifices herself, and the Mending takes place.
events.quote: with that final sacrifice, the Mending took place

events.summary: Venser gives Jhoira the ambulator and planeswalks off to an unknown destination.
events.quote: giving Jhoira the ambulator as thanks for all they had done

events.summary: Koth and Elspeth find Venser in his workshop and he shows them his planeshifting ship built from Phyrexian parts.
events.quote: Venser showed his incomplete ship to the pair

events.summary: Koth recognizes the Phyrexian parts, threatens Venser, traps his head in a stone mask and forces him to planeswalk to Mirrodin.
events.quote: trapping his head in a stone mask and commanding him to planeswalk to Mirrodin

events.summary: The group is ambushed by nim in the Mephidross, and Elspeth says she can go no further.
events.quote: the group was ambushed by nim

events.summary: Venser and Koth are captured by a Corrupted Harvester; Elspeth reappears and the trio escape and reach the Black Lacuna.
events.quote: Venser and Koth quickly fell to a Corrupted Harvester

events.summary: Venser teleports into the Black Lacuna, finds a shrine to Karn, is attacked by Geth, and sees the Phyrexian army invade the surface.
events.quote: At this shrine, he was assaulted by Geth and was forced to flee back to the surface

events.summary: The companions encounter Ezuri's rebels; Ezuri tries to stop them but backs down when Elspeth threatens him.
events.quote: When Elspeth threatened Ezuri, however, the elf backed down

events.summary: Tezzeret leads the companions to a surgery room where Elspeth kills the Phyrexians and Melira is freed.
events.quote: They freed Melira , a Mirran born without any metal on her body, from the cages.

events.summary: Melira heals everyone in Ezuri's camp of phyresis.
events.quote: She healed all those in the camp who were infected by the glistening oil

events.summary: Tezzeret captures Elspeth and Venser after Koth leaves with Melira.
events.quote: Tezzeret ordered a halt to the battle and captured the two Planeswalkers

events.summary: Koth and Melira free the pair; Tezzeret's forces fight Glissa's, letting the companions reach Karn's throne room.
events.quote: his forces did battle with Glissa's, allowing the companions to escape

events.summary: Melira cleanses Karn's body but not his heart, and Venser gives his life and spark to Karn, freeing him from Phyrexian tyranny.
events.quote: With his last remaining mana, he gave his life and spark to Karn.

events.summary: Venser's corpse is unearthed by Sheoldred's troops and woven into a Memnite goliath that serves her against Elesh Norn.
events.quote: The inventor's corpse was unearthed by Sheoldred 's troops and woven into the fabric of a new goliath Memnite

relations.quote: Venser agreed to become one of Windgrace's gladehunters

relations.note: killed it with planeswalking and powerstones
relations.quote: Venser was able to then kill the Weaver King

relations.note: infested his mind while impersonating Karn
relations.quote: The Weaver King removed Windgrace's mark and infested the young artificer's mind.

relations.note: Venser helped Karn close the Tolarian rift and gave his life for him
relations.quote: Venser then stepped into the Blind Eternities with Karn and assisted the golem

relations.note: Elspeth grew very protective of Melira
relations.quote: Elspeth grew very protective of Melira

relations.note: Bolas was the voice of Sensei Ryu
relations.quote: Bolas was fascinated with the mutated planeswalkers
